period_note: Standalone (solo) basis, from 'Condensed Balance Sheet (Unaudited) As at 30 June 2017' (p.4) and 'Condensed Profit and Loss Account (Unaudited) For the half year ended 30 June 2017' (p.7), each printed as its own separate statement immediately after the parallel Consolidated version (p.2 and p.6 respectively) - per project convention, Solo is used. Solo Total Property and Assets 260,069,660,498 vs Consolidated 285,400,578,201 (bKash/subsidiary consolidation effect). Balance sheet identity reconciles exactly: sum of Solo asset lines (16,424,617,504+18,664,030,583+0+22,693,542,002+179,525,498,248+3,242,327,126+19,456,214,960+63,430,075) = 260,069,660,498 = Total Liabilities 237,017,589,185 + Total shareholders' equity 23,052,071,313. Equity sub-components (paid-up capital 8,552,096,940 + share premium 3,738,490,072 + statutory reserve 3,470,350,332 + dividend equalization fund 355,218,455 + revaluation reserve [Govt. securities 11,306,073 + assets 516,373,535 = 527,679,608] + retained earnings 6,408,235,906) sum to 23,051,899,313, within BDT 172,000 (<0.001%) of the reported 23,052,071,313 - rounding-level, not a data-quality concern. Income-statement items are Jan-to-June-2017 cumulative (Half-Yearly filing used as the Q2 data point); the filing also separately discloses a discrete 'Quarter ended April to June 2017' column (Solo interest income 4,993,427,934; PAT 1,205,213,765; EPS 1.41) not recorded here. Every P&L subtotal reconciles exactly (NII = interest income - interest expense; total operating income = NII + investment income + commission + other income; profit before provisions = total operating income - opex; PBT = profit before provisions - total provision; PAT = PBT - tax); 'Profit before provisions' 3,755,848,608 also equals the bank's own reported 'Operating Profit' figure in the ratios note (no separate operating-profit subtotal exists in this document format). 'borrowings' is a calculated sum of four reported liability lines (borrowings from other banks/FIs, borrowings from central bank, convertible subordinate bonds, money at call and short notice-liability), matching this bank's 2016_Q3/2017_Q1 solo-filing convention; 'revaluation_reserve' likewise sums the filing's two separate reported lines (Revaluation Reserve on Government securities + Revaluation Reserve on Assets), matching the same 2017_Q1 convention; 'dividend_equalization_fund' is a new equity-reserve line first seen in this bank's 2017 filings (not present in 2015-2016 solo statements). The bank's own Selective Notes 2.1/2.2 (solo basis, p.12) independently corroborate deposits, loans, statutory reserve and equity, and give Key Financial Ratios: AD Ratio 83.70%, ROI* 9.26%, ROE* 20.89%, ROA* 1.83%, CAR 13.06% (*explicitly marked 'figures are annualized' in the source - recorded here as roa_pct/roe_pct/car_pct; AD Ratio and ROI are not in the project's metric dictionary and are left out as line items, noted here for context). No NAV-per-share figure is disclosed in this particular filing (that disclosure only starts appearing from the Q3 2017 filing onward for this bank). EPS is shown in the source as '[Previous year's/period's figure restated]' due to a 2017 stock-dividend/bonus-share issuance requiring retroactive EPS restatement per BAS 33 - a routine, expected restatement, not a data error. This is an IMAGE-based filing (no text layer, retained .txt is empty); all figures read visually from 150dpi page renders (pg-01 through pg-12).
